title: Kuiper-TTS
description: Best Paper, IEEE ISEC 2026 — End-to-end pipeline converting academic PDFs to structured LaTeX and spoken audio for visually impaired researchers.
longDescription: Kuiper-TTS is an end-to-end accessibility pipeline that converts academic PDFs into structured LaTeX and spoken audio for visually impaired researchers. The system combines custom-trained equation recognition models, layout detection, and equation OCR with LLM-based LaTeX reconstruction and neural TTS synthesis. Each stage includes per-stage validation to ensure correctness. Inference is ported to C++ for production-grade speed. Awarded Best Paper at IEEE ISEC 2026.

title: OLMo-CPP
description: 34M-parameter transformer implemented from scratch in C++17 with full attention, RoPE, KV caching, and speculative decoding — no framework dependencies beyond LibTorch.
longDescription: A 34M-parameter transformer implemented entirely from scratch in C++17 using LibTorch for tensor operations. The full forward pass is hand-written, covering multi-head attention with grouped-query attention, RoPE positional encoding, SiLU activations, QK-norm, and sliding window attention. Supports KV caching for efficient incremental decoding and multi-token prediction heads for speculative decoding. The tokenizer, weight loader, and memory management are all built from scratch with no other framework dependencies.

title: LAGEngine
description: Master's thesis — real-time 3D simulation engine with rigid-body dynamics, XPBD cloth, SPH fluids, deferred PBR rendering, and a PPO/DDPG RL auto-tuner that reduced mean frame time by 23.79%.
longDescription: LAGEngine is a real-time 3D simulation engine built from scratch in C++17 as my master's thesis. It implements rigid-body dynamics, XPBD cloth simulation, SPH fluids, deferred PBR rendering, an ECS architecture, a Chase-Lev work-stealing job scheduler, CUDA/OpenGL interop, Lua scripting, and an ImGui-based editor. A PPO/DDPG reinforcement learning auto-tuner was integrated to optimize runtime scheduling parameters, achieving a 23.79% reduction in mean frame time without destabilizing the simulation. Ships with 11 standalone demos.

title: Neural Character Generation
description: End-to-end NeRF-based pipeline to generate photorealistic, animatable 3D characters from unstructured image collections.
longDescription: A unified neural rendering pipeline for generating realistic, animatable 3D characters from sparse, messy 2D image collections. The system uses NeRFtrinsic-style pose and focal refinement with Gaussian Fourier features, builds multimodal tokens from DINOv2 features and geometric cues, and employs a transformer-based view selection module to choose informative viewpoints. An attention-augmented NeRF backbone reconstructs a high-fidelity 3D representation that supports mesh extraction, relighting, and animation for downstream use in games, XR, and avatar applications.

title: Code and Conquer
description: A gamified tower-defense learning platform that blends coding challenges with a castle-defense game loop.
longDescription: Code and Conquer is a tower-defense style learning game where players defend a castle while progressing through small, focused programming challenges. Built with Python and Pygame, it combines a casual game loop (waves of enemies, resource management, tower placement) with coding tasks that unlock abilities, upgrades, and new levels. The project explores how game mechanics, streaks, and progression systems can be used to keep learners engaged and to make foundational programming practice feel more like a game than a problem set.

title: The Market Whisperer
description: An AI- and quant-driven trading platform with deterministic analytics, risk-aware signals, and explainable recommendations.
longDescription: The Market Whisperer is a quantitative trading and research platform that combines classical factor modeling with machine learning. It ingests multi-source market data and computes calendar-aware technical features, sentiment and policy signals, and risk metrics to produce a transparent scalar score per asset. Each recommendation is backed by an auditable feature vector, risk-aware position sizing, and a human-readable explanation string that is provably grounded in stored indicators. The system is designed so every output can be reproduced from manifests and code versioning, making it suitable for systematic strategies, backtesting, and research workflows.

title: InvestorInbox
description: AI-driven email enrichment and outreach assistant for managing investor fundraising pipelines.
longDescription: InvestorInbox is an AI-assisted email and workflow tool for fundraising. It parses inbound and outbound investor emails, enriches contacts with public and interaction-derived signals, and clusters investors by stage, thesis, and prior behavior. The system helps founders prioritize warm leads, draft context-aware follow-ups, and track pipeline health. Under the hood it uses NLP models for entity extraction and intent classification, plus ranking and scoring logic to suggest the next best email to send in an investor funnel.

title: McGurk Effect
description: Stress-testing multimodal deep learning models on audio-visual incongruence (McGurk effect).
longDescription: Research project that probes how multimodal models respond to the McGurk effect, where conflicting audio and lip-motion cues produce a third perceived phoneme. The pipeline generates controlled audio–video mismatches, runs them through state-of-the-art models, and logs how prediction distributions shift relative to clean baselines. The goal is to quantify robustness and failure modes of multimodal perception systems under realistic but adversarial audio-visual incongruence, and to build benchmarks that capture these effects.

title: VitalityVR
description: VR fitness game with real-time metric tracking, analytics, and ML-based coaching features.
longDescription: VitalityVR is a Unity-based VR exercise game that turns workouts into immersive challenges while tracking key fitness metrics. Gameplay is paired with a web analytics dashboard backed by deep learning models deployed on Google Cloud. The system uses DNNs to infer user behavior and fatigue patterns and GAN-based components to suggest diet or routine variations. It was built as a full-stack VR + ML experience and has been recognized at hackathons for its combination of engagement and data-driven coaching.

title: VRProperty-Pro
description: VR house-hunting and analytics platform combining VR tours with IoT capture, ML pricing, and blockchain-backed transparency.
longDescription: VRProperty-Pro is a VR-based real-estate platform that virtualizes house hunting. Properties are captured using an IoT-enabled 360° photo device, reconstructed into immersive VR walkthroughs, and served to users so they can explore rooms and layouts remotely. The platform integrates an Ethereum-based backend for transparent, tamper-resistant transaction logs and uses a random forest regression model to provide short- and medium-term price forecasts based on location, amenities, and market trends. It was built as a hackathon project that combines Unity-based VR, IoT, blockchain, and machine learning into a single real-estate experience.

title: VR Pointer and Annotation
description: VR annotation and pointer system for instructional walkthroughs and industrial training scenarios.
longDescription: A Unity-based VR tool that enables instructors and trainers to place pointers, highlights, and annotations directly into a 3D scene. Originally developed as part of VR training modules for an Ericsson warehouse, it lets users mark equipment, define guided paths, and create step-by-step learning flows entirely in VR. The focus is on intuitive authoring of annotations, low-latency pointer updates, and clear visual feedback so the same scene can be reused for multiple training procedures without code changes.

title: Housing Walkthrough
description: Production VR housing walkthrough for an architecture firm, built with Unity and Blender assets.
longDescription: Immersive VR walkthrough application used by an architecture firm to showcase properties to clients. The pipeline combines Blender-modeled interiors and exteriors with a Unity-based Oculus application that supports teleportation, room-to-room navigation, and inspection of key design elements. The focus was on creating a smooth, comfortable experience suitable for non-technical clients while maintaining realistic lighting and scale for pre-construction property visualization.
